diffraction_fallback.source_sample: Fe-free Mg2.23(1)Si1.18(1)H2.80(6)O6, not the target EOS sample.

reference.title: Phase E: A high pressure hydrous silicate with unique crystal chemistry

structure_samples.source_location: Table 1 p. 358; footnotes a,b; pp. 357–360 disorder discussion
structure_samples.convention: All sites at (0,0,z); R-3m conventional hexagonal cell. Oxygen multiplicity 6; Z=1 for O6-normalized empirical formula. B parallel/perpendicular in angstrom^2.
structure_samples.hydrogen: Not located; formula H inferred by charge balance in this structure paper. Crichton–Ross H instead derives from EMPA deficit.
structure_samples.limitations: Average partially occupied structure; local coupled vacancies cannot be represented as simultaneous locally occupied Mg/Si positions. Absolute unit-cell content cannot be determined without absolute X-ray intensity or accurate density (p. 360). Samples differ from target; no sites copied to card.
structure_samples.source_discrepancy: Sample 1 Table 1 occupancies give Mg=3*(0.664+0.013)=2.031, not the printed formula Mg2.08; Si=6*0.193=1.158. Both table and formula are retained without correction. Sample 2 gives Mg=2.169, Si=1.014, consistent with its rounded formula. Neither sample is used as the target atom model.

thermal_assessment.reason: Source-owned HTBM and Table S1 exist, but cannot extend the Fe-bearing Crichton–Ross material. Requires a separately audited material and primary PVT/supplement recovery; no thermal parameters transferred.

calibration_source_parameters.note: Exact cited quartz scale; no marker readings from the phase E experiment are available. No registry record is added.

author_thesis_crosscheck.source_location: Section 2.11 pp. 44–45, Eq. 2.31; Table 6.1 p. 138; Results p. 137
author_thesis_crosscheck.fit_objective: Eq. 2.31 explicitly defines chi_w_squared=sum_i w_i(Pobs_i-Pcalc(Vobs_i))^2/(n-m), w_i=sigma_i^-2; sigma combines pressure error and propagated volume error. Actual propagation, weight iteration and ambient esd convention are not specified.
author_thesis_crosscheck.recommended_staging: Section 2.11 recommends starting with free V0,K0 and Kprime fixed to 4, then assessing higher order; it does not supply original phase E iteration trace or executable fit code.
author_thesis_crosscheck.bm3_result: Same V0=105.627(7), K0=92.9(7), Kprime=7.3(2), chi_w_squared=0.4 as journal.

bm2_comparison.interpretation: Thesis-only lower-order comparison; poorer fit, not installed as an additional record.

author_thesis_crosscheck.quartz_observations: No paired phase E quartz readings recovered from Chapter 6; same published P-V values, with version differences noted above.
author_thesis_crosscheck.source_terms: Thesis reproduction states author copyright, all rights reserved; ProQuest microform edition notice. Source-data reuse license unspecified.
author_thesis_crosscheck.selection: Journal Table 1 has priority for the staged record. Preserve thesis rows as a separate author version; do not merge their a or sigma_P entries into the journal dataset.
